content: Column detection recipe (ginexys.com 2026-05-30, verified fetch): naive zero-coverage x-histogram FAILS because full-width spanning elements (headers, callouts, pull quotes) fill the gutter. Working algorithm: (1) bin items into Y-bands/rows; (2) EXCLUDE bands whose horizontal span > ~55% of text width; (3) each remaining narrow band casts ONE binary vote per x-pixel it covers (immune to dense-vs-sparse disparity); (4) gutter = contiguous x-run where band-count < 20% of narrow-band count AND width >= min gutter (~1em body). pymupdf4llm column_boxes corroborates: 3-phase rectangle joining, header/footer margin exclusion (50pt default) to keep page furniture from filling gutters, reading-order sort key (P.y0, x0). Borderline cases (pull quotes = wide bands filtered out; sidebars may register as a narrow column) must be corpus-calibrated per D11-02.
